from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetricRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific financial metric extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the document")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year covered by the report (e.g. '2023')")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line-item text describing the gain/loss on fair value")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The signed numerical value of the gain or loss")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit of measure for the amount (e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    quote: str = Field(description="The verbatim line or snippet from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetricRecord]
